description: ui.render on AbovePrompt draws a 13x3 pixel athlete as one Raster plus the AMRAP score; a 280ms clock repaints frames in place with $.ui.blit and invalidates only when the caption changes; tool.call lands a rep per completed Edit/Write (thruster), Bash (burpee) or Read/Grep/Glob/Agent (pull-up) and shows a no-rep frame on an error result
